description:
The client intends to replace the existing roof covering due to its poor condition. The works will mainly involve replacing the natural slate roof with a natural Welsh slate alternative, plus any necessary repairs to the chimney, soffits, and rainwater goods. The proposals retain the existing roof profile and overall appearance while improving weatherproofing and extending the building’s lifespan.

The scheme balances the conservation area’s historic significance with the need for better durability, thermal performance, and long-term weather resistance, while preserving the original roof form and detailing. The roof is currently deteriorating, with slipped and damaged slates and evidence of water ingress, which threatens the structure and internal fabric. The replacement works will protect the building’s integrity, maintain its positive contribution to the Clyde Circus Conservation Area, and ensure the roof continues to complement the building’s original character.
